constraints.meaning: Both arrays have one value per minute, so index i means the same minute in both.
constraints.impact: One window [left, right] covers the same minutes in customers and in grumpy.

constraints.meaning: Up to 20,000 minutes. The technique always fits in the day.
constraints.impact: Trying every start and adding up the day from scratch is O(n²), about 4 × 10⁸ steps: too slow. One pass with a window of fixed size minutes is O(n).

constraints.meaning: No negative counts; a minute can have no customers.
constraints.impact: The total is at most 2 × 10⁴ × 1000 = 2 × 10⁷, so int is enough in C and C++.

constraints.meaning: Each minute the owner is either calm (0) or grumpy (1).
constraints.impact: Calm minutes are satisfied anyway. The technique only changes grumpy minutes, so the window only needs to count customers where grumpy[i] = 1.

bruteForce.summary: try every start of the technique. For each start, go through the whole day and add the customers of calm minutes and of minutes inside the technique. Keep the largest total. O(n²) time, about 4 × 10⁸ steps for n = 2 × 10⁴: too slow.
